_comment: Corpora that cannot currently be scored because cognium-dev fails on them. Each entry suppresses the regression this failure would otherwise raise, and ONLY that failure — a different error, or any other corpus failing, still fails the run. An entry whose corpus starts working also fails the run, so the list cannot quietly rot into a permanent amnesty. This is an exemption register, not a way to make a red gate green.

failures.note: Cross-file regex crash: an identifier is interpolated into a pattern unescaped, so Python's *args yields /\b*args\b/ and the whole scan aborts with exit 2. Reproduces only on a directory, never on any single file.
Cross-file scan hangs on 25 JavaScript files. Every file scans fine individually; only the directory scan never returns.
Same hang as nodegoat, on 11 Go files.
